# Acme API

> Acme is a payments API. These docs cover authentication, payments and webhooks.

## Get started

- [Quickstart]({{ORIGIN}}/quickstart.md): Make your first API request
- [Authentication]({{ORIGIN}}/authentication.md): API keys and key scopes

## Guides

- [Webhooks]({{ORIGIN}}/guides/webhooks.md): Receive payment events and verify their signatures
- [Webhook signatures explained]({{OFFSITE}}/blog/webhook-signatures.md): an off-site post that must not be fetched
